# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 51 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Tablets Found by Solomon; Closing Colophon

---

**51:1** In the days of Solomon king of Israel, the tablets of Seth were found. Solomon read them and gave thanks to God.

**51:2** Solomon had all the words copied and written in the books of the kings of Israel.

**51:3** This is the end of the life of Adam and Eve, the first of all the living, whose hope is in the mercy of God.

**51:4** Glory be to God, who has mercy on all his creatures, now and forever.

---
